citations.narrative:
The facility reported two separate incidents where nonhuman primates (Cynomolgus macaques) were found outside of
their primary enclosures inside the animal room. The first incident had occurred on February 27, 2026, when one male
adult NHP (ID: USDA211601) was found outside of its enclosure within the animal room after he opened its own
enclosure and was able to exit. The adult NHP once outside of his primary enclosure got into an altercation with another
housed NHP. The animals sustained injuries that were treated by the attending veterinarian and the animals fully
recovered. The second incident occurred on June 8, 2026, when two adult females NHPs (ID: USDA213229 and
USDA2212332) were found outside of their enclosure but inside the animal room after one of the animals opened the
enclosure from within. One of the animals was found to have a small skin abrasion that was treated by the attending
veterinarian and the animal recovered. The IACUC team investigated the incidents, and they determined that the animals
had opened their respective cages from within.
Primary enclosures that do not securely contain the animal can lead to animal escapes, stress, injuries, and other
hazards. Animal enclosures must be maintained so that they contain the non-human primates securely and prevent
accidental opening of the enclosure, including opening by the animal.
Correct by: October 20, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Attending Veterinarian, IACUC Chair, and Facility
Representatives.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
